children: CoreWeave's shares are sliding again premarket.
The stock is down 4% ahead of the bell.
It is on track to fall nearly 20% this week, which would mark its worst performance since Nov. 2025.

Investors have dumped the crypto-miner-turned AI cloud-computing provider's stock (and bonds) this week as they question how it will cope with higher borrowing costs. CoreWeave has borrowed heavily to fund its business of leasing out AI chips to hyperscalers. Upbeat comments from Nvidia's Jensen Huang helped the stock rebound yesterday, but the boost proved short lived.
